name: Jotform
description:
Create, edit and manage forms, view and analyze form submissions through Claude.

Instead of complex builders, simply describe what you need and watch the form take shape. Build quizzes, manage RSVPs, collect feedback, and more without hassle.

You can search and retrieve forms, view submissions in real time, filter responses using natural language, and get instant insights. This enables faster analysis and more efficient form management: all without leaving your chat.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jotform to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jotform to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.jotform.com/mcp-app. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Jotform MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 16, 2026, Jotform scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Jotform MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jotform provides these MCP tools: form_list, create_form, edit_form, create_submission, get_submissions, search, fetch, assign_form, list_submissions, display_form, and analyze_submissions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Jotform?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Jotform in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Jotform requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Jotform failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jotform scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Jotform is developed by Jotform. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
